scenes.narration: One of these jars is hiding REAL gold — but which one?!
We've got a red jar, a blue jar, and a green jar. Pick your favorite — fast!
The answer is coming — three, two, one!
The RED jar? Nope — just a rubber duck in there. Quack!
The BLUE jar? Oh no — it's full of spaghetti! Yikes!
The GREEN jar — open it up — and YES! Shiny gold coins everywhere!
Did you get it right? Level Two is coming tomorrow — don't miss it!
